title: Lieb's Permanental Dominance Conjecture for Ordinary Immanants through Order Fifteen
summary: Pate proved ordinary irreducible-immanant permanental dominance through order $13$ and identified $(4,4,3,3)$ as the sole remaining order-$14$ case, with $(5,4,3,3)$ and $(3^5)$ forming the order-$15$ frontier. These three cases are settled here; consequently $d_λ(A)/f^λ\le \operatorname{per}(A)$ for every partition $λ\vdash n$ with $n\le15$ and every complex Hermitian positive-semidefinite matrix $A$. The argument also yields results beyond this finite frontier: an exact four-term bridge for $(4,4,3,3)$, the uniform family $(m,4,3,3)$, a two-parameter family $(a,b,3,3)$ for $a\ge b\ge4$ and…
